# Fiji original repair cohort: source and native assessment

Issue #2219. Original package `gb-FJI-ADM2--repair-evaluation` contains exactly
3,963 land cells, 1,882 half-open segments and 15 owners. No denominator was
substituted. The original frozen selected vintage is a61b6f9e7f88b1da380e3a834f89d7509132ed71;
initial comparison baseline was ab0d2088bc66e0d9847b273eb8519a92c0f109b1.
The current composition baseline is e67e5518a68aa031c05573c487bb4a94804b94c0,
which includes the accepted Solomon Islands repair delivery.
The retained source queue is authenticated by SHA256
78007430b6f9faedb188ef0619b7ff0a7a2cc7fff2ec9f1c41ee69936ec4ebd8.

## Complete source custody and source-to-target meaning

`complete-source-context.json` authenticates every original byte of both retained
products: gb:FJI:ADM1 (4 features, 37,225 bytes, represented-year claim 2006,
CC BY 2.5) and gb:FJI:ADM2 (15 features, 335,438 bytes, represented-year claim
2020, CC BY 4.0). The consumed geoBoundaries revision is 9469f09 and the product
URLs are explicitly the simplified GeoJSONs. Full-resolution URLs in current
feature display metadata are not substituted for these actual consumed bytes.
No new current-law or full-resolution identity claim is made.

All 15 ADM2 members are exact direct source/target identities. The complete
original feature, current selected feature, stable owner index and accepted Fiji
reference-owner identity are retained. There are no borrowed aggregation members
or invented owner identities. Current Fiji part-8 bytes equal the frozen source
selection. Existing hierarchy, regional reference, city aliases and open semantic
review status are unchanged. ADM1 Northern/Eastern/Central/Western are complete
source context, not a new owner roster or an assignment package.

## Whole geometry, physical support and exclusions

The stock physical producer ran against the unchanged whole original stages,
full retained native source members, complete candidate/source queries, and an
authenticated Python 3.12.14 / NumPy 2.3.5 / Shapely 2.1.2 / GEOS 3.13.1 runtime.
`physical-001/execution-receipt.json` binds all 25 inputs and the exact runtime.
It retains missing/extra reconstruction witnesses for Tailevu, Bua and Kadavu.
Those witnesses are not waived: the unchanged constructor tested them at every
requested native centre and found no contact within these 3,963 cells.

Every original ADM2 member remains a competitor before spatial filtering.
Coverage is only mapped-land support. Explicit territorial exclusion rosters are
empty because this bounded source claim introduces no additional territorial
interpretation; existing outside-context, water/hierarchy and reconstruction
negatives remain active. Small islands, remote Rotuma, and all original polygon
parts remain in complete inputs. No area threshold, island omission, bounding-box
substitute or sampled polygon grants coverage.

## Explicit dateline view and unchanged numerical meaning

Two original ADM2 geometries contain ten positions at 180.0000000000001:
Cakaudrove (8) and Macuata (2). The original bytes are retained. The accepted
`scripts/majority.py:canonical` recipe derives an explicit view, rather than
mutating or silently clamping coordinates. `canonical-views-001` binds two source,
four support and four complete query-witness views. All ten operands retain
identical complete native row spans and exact boundary ties under the normative
latitude table. Reproduction authenticates the original method and every runtime
file and matches both retained outputs byte-for-byte.

The frozen canonical views for ADM1 Northern and both ADM2 members are separately
rejoined to the complete original family bodies and prove the same native
pointsets. The new qualifier validates each original geometry digest, selected
method, and every whole native span/tie before admitting an explicit view.
Ordinary strict scanning is unchanged. Material overrun, changed spans/ties,
wrong digest, duplicate or foreign operands, and omitted competitor views refuse.

## Exact result and current conservation

The stock diagnostic and stock authority both qualify all 3,963 requested cells;
there are zero held cells in this repair cohort. The original physical companion
contains 9,706 cells and remains unassigned and outside this denominator. The
50,275-cell ADM1 location-mapping package is also unassigned.

the current selected native bank and all complete intervals on the 1,195
requested rows (three whole native run parts), proving all 3,963 cells still have
native owner zero. The current cumulative additive patch has zero intersection.
All 886 inherited ledger rows and 146 authorities remain literal; 15 rows and one
authority add exactly 3,963 disjoint keys. Current `composition-002` contains
295,176 cumulative additive cells, compared with 291,213 at this baseline. The
existing reference-metadata projection remains unchanged. The original
constructor at 0dc80808373b6437877933e808572792ab61bc6b is reused unchanged;
no physical or source qualification was recomputed or reinterpreted.

## Controls and remaining acceptance

The focused native, diagnostic, package/cold-role and constructor/entry suite
passes all 373 tests in the resumed complete bounded run. No skipped controls.
Whole-view reproduction and stock source/native/compose/finalize phases passed.
The shared fresh-vintage publisher handles reproduction outputs; actual occupied
destination, symlink destination and symlink ancestor controls reject before
mutation and retain identical bytes. The three retained-report verifiers are
read-only comparisons, not report overwriters. The actual-Fiji regression test
authenticates the original encoded/decoded latitude bytes; it does not regenerate
latitudes with platform math. Production and reproduction use that exact table.

The reproducer authenticates the original local source, physical evidence and
execution receipt against their immutable Git pins, including the original
encoded/decoded latitude identities and every admitted runtime file. It passes
the captured source and physical bodies, with their exact byte lengths and
SHA256s, to Python through stdin. Python verifies and consumes those captured
bodies without reopening mutable geometry paths. The bounded transport test
changes isolated local files after capture and proves the actual Python reader
still consumes the captured originals; changed payload lengths, hashes and
bodies fail. Fresh reproduction after this change is byte-identical to both
retained canonical view and whole-native comparison products.

This is local source/native qualification and exact literal conservation. Final
hosted combined geographic verification and emitted selected-consumer smoke,
independent source/code review of the actual head, and root serial merge remain
required. Accepted package/cell credit is zero before merge. No regional
certification, historical approval, deployment or production publication follows.
